subject: Cartology trial: proposed success metrics, eval split, and next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@cartology.co>, Priya Anand <priya.anand@cartology.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Cartology trial: proposed success metrics, eval split, and next steps

Hi Jamie / Priya — thanks again for a productive discovery today. Quick recap plus a concrete proposal so we can lock the scope and calendar for the trial.

TL;DR proposal (please confirm):
- Hybrid evaluation: 1 week offline evaluation on a labeled seed (sanitized) dataset + 3 weeks online shadow against live traffic (shadowing only; no production writes).
- Success criteria (pass/fail gates):
  - Business KPIs: +5% engagement lift on recommended items (primary), <2% erroneous recommendations flagged by ops (secondary).
  - Model quality: weighted score >= 78/100 on our rubric (precision/recall + human relevance grading).
  - Latency: median inference <150ms p99 <400ms for 95% of calls.
- Ownership: Cartology to provide sample labeled set and data access (Priya). Redwood will provide test harness, scoring pipeline, and a shadowing runbook.
- Timeline (target):
  - Week 0: SSO + dataset handoff + procurement kick-off
  - Week 1: Offline run + rubric grading on seed set
  - Weeks 2–4: Shadowing + weekly checkpoint calls
  - End of week 4: Go/No-go decision and recommended rollout plan

Attachments: I attached a short metrics template (cartology-poc-metrics.xlsx) showing the signals we'll track and a draft mutual action plan.

Open questions for you:
1) Can you confirm a downstream owner for quality flags/ops (who will triage false positives)?
2) Any regulatory/PII constraints on the seed set we should know about before we accept samples?
3) Are there any hard blackout windows during the proposed 2–4 week window?

If that looks good, we'll update the mutual action plan and get procurement looped in. Happy to shift the offline/shadow split if you prefer a shorter shadow period.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachments: cartology-poc-metrics.xlsx (xlsx), MultiActionPlan_Cartology_v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Karthik — the plan reads well. A few notes from our side:

- We prefer 1 week offline + 2 weeks shadow (we want to move faster on the shadowing to see live distribution effects).
- Priya will own the labeled seed and the ops triage owner will be Samir Patel (cc: procurement looped for contract items).
- We have an internal requirement to enable SSO before any shadowing (good to know for scheduling).
- Regarding PII: seed set will be pseudonymized; we will share the data sample by Friday (2026-07-24).

Can you circulate the revised timeline with the 1+2 split and an action item for SSO setup? Procurement asked for the mutual action plan and a ballpark invoice and timeline for Dedicated slot reservation if we choose to go forward.

—Jamie

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: resource & rubric notes for Cartology run

Internal note (not to be shared externally) — quick alignment on engineering and eval rubric:

- Eng resources: assigning Priyanka Rao (engineer) for SSO/sandbox work and Omar Chen (inference engineer) for shadow integration. Both available starting 7/26.
- Eval rubric (proposed weights):
  - Precision @ top-K (40%)
  - Human relevance grading (30%) — 100-item blind sample from Cartology labeled by their PMs and our SMEs
  - Business KPI lift (engagement conversion) (20%)
  - Runtime/latency penalty (10%) — heavier penalty if p99 > 400ms
  - Passing threshold: >=78/100. Borderline (74–77): require remediation and a 1-week re-run in shadow.
- Contingency: if ops flags >2% erroneous recommendations during shadow, we will pause the run and execute a rapid rollback + analysis runbook.

I'll draft the scoring sheet and share to the internal folder; Marissa — confirm estimated SSO effort (hours) so we can include in the mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Logan
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
